content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Degree in Civil Engineering (for an officer taken on deputation); Superintending Engineer (Civil) or Executive Engineer (Civil) from CPWD, failing which similar officers from other Central Engineering Departments or Engineering Departments of Central Statutory/Autonomous bodies; Departmental: Executive Engineers of AIIMS with 5 years of regular service in the grade Experience: 5 years of regular service in that grade Age limit: Maximum 56 years Other conditions: Must be Superintending Engineer (Civil) or Executive Engineer (Civil) with 5 years of regular service in that grade Application must be forwarded through proper channel

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications without vigilance clearance and APAR Dossiers will not be considered

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Period of deputation shall not exceed 3 years Deputation governed by DoPT O.M. No. 06/08/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time If an AIIMS Executive Engineer is selected, the appointment shall be treated as promotion

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed proforma at Annexure-I Recent coloured passport size photograph affixed on the form Duly attested photocopies of up to date APAR for at least the latest 05 years Statement that no vigilance/disciplinary proceedings are pending or contemplated Form countersigned by the Employer/Authorized Officer

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the prescribed proforma at Annexure-I of the notice. Send the application through proper channel to the Director, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi-110029. Superscribe the envelope 'Application for the post of Superintending Engineer on Deputation Basis'. Forwarding office must verify the candidate's particulars and eligibility. Enclose duly attested photocopies of up to date APAR for at least the latest 05 years and a vigilance clearance statement. Application must reach the addressee on or before 15.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Forwarding office must verify candidate particulars and eligibility AIIMS Executive Engineers are considered along with deputation applicants

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Superintending Engineer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of this notice (pages 3-4)) and send it to The Director, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi-110029, by through proper channel, in a superscribed envelope, to reach by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level-13 in the Pay Matrix (pre-revised PB-4 Rs. 37400-67000 + Grade Pay Rs. 8700).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Superintending Engineer (Civil) or Executive Engineer (Civil) with 5 years of regular service in that grade from CPWD, failing which similar officers from other Central Engineering Departments or Engineering Departments of Central Statutory/Autonomous bodies; Degree in Civil Engineering. Executive Engineers of AIIMS with 5 years of regular service in the grade also considered.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be Superintending Engineer (Civil) or Executive Engineer (Civil) with 5 years of regular service in that grade. Application must be forwarded through proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications without vigilance clearance and APAR Dossiers will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Period of deputation shall not exceed 3 years. Deputation governed by DoPT O.M. No. 06/08/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time. If an AIIMS Executive Engineer is selected, the appointment shall be treated as promotion.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: NCI, Jhajjar.
